identity.what_it_is: Sunnyside North Beach - the only legal clothing-optional (nudist) beach on Port Phillip Bay / metropolitan Melbourne, and one of only three legally designated clothing-optional beaches in Victoria.
identity.where: Mount Eliza, Mornington Peninsula, Victoria, Australia - reached from a carpark at the end of Sunnyside Road, about 12km from Frankston and roughly an hour's drive south of Melbourne.
aliases: Sunnyside (the clothing-optional section of Sunnyside Beach)
identity.warnings: The scaffold's blanket 'Sunnyside Beach' identity is imprecise: the legally clothing-optional area is specifically 'Sunnyside North Beach', a stretch beginning ~500m north of the main Sunnyside Road carpark - the beach immediately next to that carpark is NOT the legal nude section (Wikipedia). The scaffold's 'Humphries Road clifftop descent' access claim is unsupported: every harvested source names Sunnyside Road as the access road via a ~500m dirt-path/rocky walk; Humphries Road is confirmed only as a Mount Eliza suburb-boundary road (Wikipedia), not a beach access route. Do not conflate with Southside Beach or Point Impossible Beach, two other Victorian clothing-optional beaches near Torquay (176km away) - 'Southside' vs 'Sunnyside' is an easy near-dupe mistake.

spike_candidates.statement: Council nearly revoked Melbourne's only nudist beach's 1986 status in 2022; 92% of 4,000 backed it, but safety upgrades stayed unmet by 2023.
spike_candidates.tension: A council report blamed the beach for drug use, syringes and 'illegal activities' and nearly stripped its 36-year clothing-optional status, but organizers say those problems happened in the carpark and bushland, not on the sand - and even after the council reversed course under overwhelming public support, the promised cameras, signage and access-track repairs still hadn't materialized a year later.

spike_candidates.statement: The 1867 mansion beside the beach, later a Catholic boys' home until 1975, is now a heritage estate that was relisted for sale at up to $40 million.
spike_candidates.tension: A genteel Victorian-era rose-garden estate built for weddings sits directly beside a beach whose entire public identity is a decades-long political fight over legal nudity - two wildly different images of the same stretch of coast competing for control of the area's reputation.

facts.fact: Sunnyside North Beach is a clothes-optional beach south of Mount Eliza on Port Phillip Bay, about 12 kilometres from Frankston, Victoria, Australia.
facts.quote: sunnyside north beach is a clothes-optional beach located south of mount eliza , port philip bay and approximately 12 kilometres from frankston in the state of victoria , australia
facts.source_title: Sunnyside North Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: The beach is legally designated a nudist beach under the Nudity (Prescribed Areas) Act 1983.
facts.quote: it is designated as a legal nudist beach
facts.source_title: Sunnyside North Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: It is the only clothes-optional beach on the east side of Port Phillip Bay.
facts.quote: it is the only clothes-optional beach on the east side of port philip bay.
facts.source_title: Sunnyside North Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: The beach sits south of Moondah Beach and north of Bidwell Beach.
facts.quote: the beach is south of moondah beach and north of bidwell beach.
facts.source_title: Sunnyside North Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: The beach directly next to the Sunnyside Road carpark is not itself the legal nude beach - the designated area starts further along.
facts.quote: the beach immediately next to the car park at the end of sunnyside road is not the legal nude beach.
facts.source_title: Sunnyside North Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Access to the legal nude section is from the right side of the carpark, about 500 metres from where the nude beach begins.
facts.quote: access to the legal nude section is from the right side of the car park which is approximately 500 meters from the start of the nude beach.
facts.source_title: Sunnyside North Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Visitors reach the beach via a winding dirt path through scrub, or by walking the beach itself over a rocky section.
facts.quote: the walk north can be taken via a winding dirt path through scrub or via the beach which has a rocky section to navigate.
facts.source_title: Sunnyside North Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Facilities at the carpark include toilets, showers and free electric barbecues at the far end.
facts.quote: there are toilets and showers located next to the car park and free electric barbeques at the far end of the carpark.
facts.source_title: Sunnyside North Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: The beach is not patrolled by lifesavers.
facts.quote: the beach is not patrolled by lifesavers.
facts.source_title: Sunnyside North Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: There are exactly three legally clothing-optional beaches in Victoria: Sunnyside North, Point Impossible near Torquay, and Southside near Point Addis.
facts.quote: there are three beaches in victoria that are legally classed as "clothing-optional": sunnyside north beach, point impossible, near torquay, and one at southside, at nearby point addis.
facts.source_title: Nudists could be forced to cover up at Victoria's Sunnyside North Beach - ABC News

facts.fact: Humphries Road is a Mount Eliza suburb-boundary road, not the beach's access route - the scaffold's Humphries Road access claim does not match any source.
facts.quote: the suburb is bordered by kackeraboite creek, humphries road, moorooduc highway , wooralla drive, the mornington railway line , oakbank road, manyung creek, and port phillip .
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia

facts.fact: The beach was declared clothing-optional in 1986, and had held that status for 36 years as of the 2022 controversy.
facts.quote: it was declared a clothing-optional beach in 1986.
facts.source_title: Michael has been going to this nudist beach for 26 years - SBS News

facts.fact: Paid parking at Sunnyside was introduced at $6.20 an hour or $19.50 all day, from 8am to 8pm, as part of a 2023 trial.
facts.quote: it will cost $6.20 an hour or $19.50 all day to park at sunnyside from 8am to 8pm.
facts.source_title: No easy access to nude beach - MPNews

facts.fact: The next-closest clothing-optional beach, Point Impossible near Torquay, is 176 kilometres each way from Sunnyside North - a 4-5 hour round trip.
facts.quote: the next closest is pt impossible near torquay and is 176 kilometres each way from sunnyside north clothing optional beach.
facts.source_title: No easy access to nude beach - MPNews

facts.fact: On 1 November 2021, Mornington Peninsula Shire resolved to write to the state planning minister seeking a review of the beach's clothing-optional status.
facts.quote: mornington peninsula shire will write to planning minister richard wynne seeking a review and public consultation into the clothing-optional status of mount eliza's nude beach, sunnyside north.
facts.source_title: Call for fresh look at nude beach - MPNews

facts.fact: The November 2021 motion calling for a review of the clothing-optional status was carried unanimously by council.
facts.quote: it was carried unanimously.
facts.source_title: Call for fresh look at nude beach - MPNews

facts.fact: A prior review of the beach's status was proposed in 2006 by the shire, but the clothing-optional designation was never removed.
facts.quote: while it seems that the shire of mornington and later mornington peninsula shire opposed the gazettal and a review was proposed in 2006, the clothing option status remains
facts.source_title: Call for fresh look at nude beach - MPNews

facts.fact: A 2022 council report alleged the beach's carpark and surrounding bluffs regularly saw drug use, sexual activity and hazardous rubbish including syringes.
facts.quote: anecdotal evidence suggests drug use and sexual activities take place regularly at the carpark and beach during all times of the day and night, resulting in hazardous rubbish, such as syringes, being left on the beach and within the carpark, and surrounding bluffs,
facts.source_title: Nudists could be forced to cover up at Victoria's Sunnyside North Beach - ABC News

facts.fact: Naturist Michael's Facebook group 'Keep Sunnyside Beach Clothing Optional' had more than 870 followers by May 2022.
facts.quote: michael runs a facebook group called "keep sunnyside beach clothing optional" which has more than 870 followers.
facts.source_title: Michael has been going to this nudist beach for 26 years - SBS News

facts.fact: Michael's change.org petition 'Save Sunnyside North Clothing Optional Beach' had garnered almost 800 signatures by May 2022.
facts.quote: he has also launched a change.org petition - "save sunnyside north clothing optional beach" - that has garnered almost 800 signatures.
facts.source_title: Michael has been going to this nudist beach for 26 years - SBS News

facts.fact: A separate petition on gopetition.com, started by Michael James, had only 11 signatures as of 4 May 2022.
facts.quote: save sunnyside north beach 11 signatures may 4 2022 michael james
facts.source_title: Sign Petition: Save Sunnyside North Beach - GoPetition

facts.fact: By December 2022, the change.org petition to save the beach had grown to over 1,800 signatures.
facts.quote: the petition, which garnered over 1,800 signatures, said that for over three decades
facts.source_title: Council backs down over calls to shut down Melbourne's only nude beach - Star Observer

facts.fact: A council community consultation found about 92% of roughly 4,000 respondents supported keeping the beach's clothing-optional status.
facts.quote: a community consultation by the council found that around 92% of 4000 people surveyed supported maintaining the clothing-optional status of sunnyside north beach.
facts.source_title: Council backs down over calls to shut down Melbourne's only nude beach - Star Observer

facts.fact: Mornington Peninsula Shire Council voted on 6 December 2022 to retain the beach's clothing-optional status.
facts.quote: mornington peninsula shire council voted on december 6 to maintain the clothing-optional status of the sunnyside north beach located at mount eliza.
facts.source_title: Council backs down over calls to shut down Melbourne's only nude beach - Star Observer

facts.fact: The council's 2022 consultation drew almost 4,000 submissions, described by the mayor as possibly the most ever received for a community consultation.
facts.quote: mayor anthony marsh said the council received almost 4,000 submissions from people across the country.
facts.source_title: Michael has been going to this nudist beach for 26 years - SBS News

facts.fact: Michael, who led the campaign and had been a regular for 25+ years, called the council's reversal an emotional moment.
facts.quote: michael, who has been a regular at sunnyside north for more than 25 years and spearheaded the campaign to save its clothing-optional status, said it was an "emotional" moment.
facts.source_title: Michael spearheaded a campaign to save this nudist beach - SBS News

facts.fact: Alongside retaining clothing-optional status, council passed a motion seeking state funding for police monitoring, car-park bays, surveillance cameras, signage, toilets and access fixes.
facts.quote: they also passed a motion to seek government support and funding "for urgent matters concerning police monitoring, car park bays, surveillance cameras, signage, toilets and access problems".
facts.source_title: Council backs down over calls to shut down Melbourne's only nude beach - Star Observer

facts.fact: By October 2023, the access track from the carpark to the clothing-optional section remained poorly maintained, with an outdated sign still left on the rocks.
facts.quote: although the track leading from the car park to optional clothing section of the beach had been poorly maintained and a sign remained on the rocks (despite his notifying council)
facts.source_title: No easy access to nude beach - MPNews

facts.fact: As of October 2023, no visible progress had been made on the safety and infrastructure upgrades the council promised in December 2022.
facts.quote: james said there was no evidence "to a regular beach goer of any progress in any of these areas, but of course, it could still be in the planning stage by [the shire]".
facts.source_title: No easy access to nude beach - MPNews

facts.fact: Michael described beach regulars as ordinary people - "lawyers, bankers, working in a supermarket" - not a fringe group.
facts.quote: the people who go to the beach, in the vast majority, are people like you and i,
facts.source_title: Nudists could be forced to cover up at Victoria's Sunnyside North Beach - ABC News

facts.fact: Michael, who is gay, said the beach has long served as a safe gathering space for the LGBTIQ+ community.
facts.quote: the queer community has been using the beach as a safe space of gathering for many years ... and we would argue that [the clothing-optional status] needs to be retained on that basis for that community.
facts.source_title: Michael has been going to this nudist beach for 26 years - SBS News

facts.fact: The Sunnyside estate beside the beach was purchased by London merchant Francis Alfred Gillett in 1865, who built the Sunnyside mansion around 1867-1870.
facts.quote: the sunnyside estate, now known as the morning star estate, was purchased by francis alfred gillett in 1865, a short time after he arrived in the colony in 1853 from london.
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia

facts.fact: In 1932 the Catholic Church purchased the mansion's estate, which became Morning Star Boys' Home, a training centre for delinquent boys.
facts.quote: in 1932 the property was purchased, with funds from a bequest , by the catholic church and became known as morning star boys' home.
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Morning Star Boys' Home closed in 1975.
facts.quote: the home closed in 1975.
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia

facts.fact: The 63-hectare Morning Star Estate, with its vineyard, mansion, 20-room hotel and helipad, was listed for sale in 2017 with $30 million in expectations.
facts.quote: with a development permit for a 72-room hotel - was listed for sale in 2017 with expectations of $30 million.
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Morning Star Estate is home to possibly the largest rose garden in Victoria, with 75,000 rose bushes.
facts.quote: the morning star estate is also home to possibly the largest rose garden in victoria, with 75,000 rose bushes,
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia

facts.fact: The film Partisan, starring Vincent Cassel, was shot on the Morning Star Estate over three months during 2013-2014.
facts.quote: a number of films were shot on the estate, including the movie partisan , starring french actor vincent cassel , over three months during 2013 and 2014
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Mount Eliza, the suburb adjoining the beach, recorded a population of 18,734 at the 2021 census.
facts.quote: mount eliza recorded a population of 18,734 at the 2021 census.
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Mount Eliza is a seaside suburb on the Mornington Peninsula, 42km south-east of Melbourne's CBD.
facts.quote: mount eliza is a seaside suburb on the mornington peninsula in melbourne , victoria , australia , 42 km (26 mi) south-east of melbourne's central business district
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia

facts.fact: A 19 June 2020 press citation records Morning Star Estate relisted for sale at $40 million, higher than its 2017 asking price.
facts.quote: morning star estate, mt eliza for sale for $40 million
facts.source_title: Mount Eliza, Victoria - Wikipedia (citing Herald Sun, 19 June 2020)

facts.fact: Point Impossible Beach, a comparison beach near Torquay, is a surf beach about 30 minutes' drive from Geelong.
facts.quote: it is a surf beach on the eastern outskirts of torquay . it is about 30 minutes drive from geelong.
facts.source_title: Point Impossible Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Point Impossible Beach is itself a separate clothes-optional beach under the same 1983 Act - not to be confused with Sunnyside North.
facts.quote: point impossible beach is a clothes-optional beach
facts.source_title: Point Impossible Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Southside Beach (also near Torquay, easily confused with 'Sunnyside') itself replaced a previously legal nude beach whose status had been revoked - a real precedent for what revocation looks like.
facts.quote: it replaced the previously legal beach just west of point addis when that beach's status was revoked.
facts.source_title: Southside Beach - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Sunnyside Beach carries a general beach hazard rating of 3 out of 10, among the least hazardous ratings.
facts.quote: sunnyside beach has a general beach hazard rating of 3/10 (least hazardous).
facts.source_title: Sunnyside Beach (Mount Eliza) - Melbourne Playgrounds

facts.fact: The beach is dominated by sandstone rocks, reefs and bluffs, with a rocky north end and a shortish sandy stretch.
facts.quote: sunnyside beach is dominated by sandstone rocks, reefs and bluffs.
facts.source_title: Sunnyside Beach (Mount Eliza) - Melbourne Playgrounds

facts.fact: The Nudity (Prescribed Areas) Act 1983 lets the state planning minister, after consulting the council, prescribe or revoke an area's legal nudity status - the exact mechanism the 2022 fight was fought over.
facts.quote: the nudity (prescribed areas) act 1983 provides that the minister, after consultation with the council, may prescribe an area where nudity is permitted, or may revoke that previous approval.
facts.source_title: Sign Petition: Save Sunnyside North Beach - GoPetition

recency.newest_item: MPNews, 25 Oct 2023: paid parking ($6.20/hr or $19.50/day, 8am-8pm) began at the Sunnyside carpark, and beach users reported no visible progress on the access-track, signage and surveillance upgrades council promised when it retained the beach's clothing-optional status in December 2022.

conflicts: Petition signature counts vary by platform and date: GoPetition's own petition had only 11 signatures as of 4 May 2022 (F21), while SBS reported a separate change.org petition had 'almost 800' signatures by mid-May 2022 (F20), which Star Observer then put at 'over 1,800' by December 2022 (F22) - these are different petitions on different platforms, not one inconsistent count.

Morning Star Estate's asking price: Wikipedia's body text cites a 2017 listing 'with expectations of $30 million' (F35), while a 2020 citation title in the same article records it 'for sale for $40 million' (F40) - likely a relisting at a higher price three years later rather than a direct contradiction, but no full article in this bundle confirms which figure is current.
